item.title: More Republican-led states ban student IDs for voting
item.description: New restrictions in Indiana and New Hampshire prohibit using student IDs at the polls, prompting lawsuits and raising concerns about voter access.

item.title: App helps workers overcome car trouble and childcare gaps
item.description: An app provides last-minute support for transportation, food, and childcare, reducing costly absences for employers.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, known for 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
item.description: Starting as an infant in commercials, Panettiere gained fame as country star Juliette in 'Nashville' and as Claire in 'Heroes.'
